project.title: Wastewater monitoring for SARS-CoV-2 across the United States (HHS Protect/NWSS/Biobot Analytics)
project.description: Sequencing of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater samples collected across the United States, for genomic surveillance. Sequencing project led by Biobot Analytics with support from CDC/NWSS (the National Wastewater Surveillance System) and HHS.
